name: 89044 · Henderson, NV
findings: ZIP 89044 (Henderson) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89044 (Henderson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89044 (Henderson) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
